title: Tree Bricks and Finite Tree Automata
summary: Let $Λ=KQ/I$ be a finite-dimensional zero-relation algebra. We encode Crawley--Boevey tree modules over $Λ$ by finite rooted trees labelled by arrows of $Q$ and their formal inverses, and construct a deterministic finite bottom-up tree automaton recognizing exactly these encodings. We define an accepted tree to be an automata-induced tree brick when it has no non-trivial factor--image self-overlap, and use Crawley--Boevey's graph-map basis to prove that this is equivalent to brickness of the associated tree module.
